repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire at 29000 ms. The IR requires a 30-second duration on a 100 ms grid, which corresponds to 301 ticks (30 seconds + 1 initial tick), so the action must fire at 30000 ms. Using a 1000 ms wrapper cannot observe the condition dropping and re-arming between iterations, so the wrapper period must be 100.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 100 and adjusted the threshold to 301 to align with the IR's 30-second sustained requirement on a 100 ms grid. This ensures the action fires exactly at 30000 ms as required.
